result.verdictNote: The resume is dense with quantified, client-facing and leadership evidence, and the scale and selectivity signals are strong. The main concern is the timeline. The postdoc (2022 – 2026), the co-founder/CTO role (2023 – Present) and the Accenture role (Jan 2026 – Present) overlap, and nothing says whether any of them is part-time. Some terms (NLP, NPV, CRO, preclinical) are not explained. R24 can't be assessed from this input. R17, R01, R09, R21, R25, R23 and R22 do not apply.
